test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Chief Minister of which state has inaugurated a project of the Women and Child Development department to provide milk and eggs to children at all anganwadis in the state in a bid to improve their nutrition levels?
solution:
The correct answer is __Kerala__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan inaugurated a project of the Women and Child Development department to provide milk and eggs to children at all anganwadis in the state.
 
• Kerala government has set aside over Rs 61.5 crore to include milk and eggs in the anganwadi menu.
 
• Each child will be given 125 ml of milk two days a week for 44 weeks (10 months) and an egg twice a week.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Kerala:

 
 
• Chief Minister - Pinarayi Vijayan.
 
• Governor - Arif Mohammad Khan.
 
• Number of Districts - 14.
 
• Lok Sabha seats - 20.
 
• Rajya Sabha seats - 9.
 
• State Animal - Indian elephant.
 
• State Bird - Great hornbill.
